label: rem:hopf-diquark-physical
title: Borromean contrast and the CFL flavor-antisymmetric channel
html:
Borromean baryon contrast. In the confined phase, quarks are Borromean-linked (Borromean quark). No two components are pairwise linked. This prevents any stable two-quark subsystem. The Hopf diquark violates this. Its two components are pairwise linked with linking number \pm 1. A Hopf diquark requires disrupting the Borromean topology.

Flavor-antisymmetric channel. The largest binding requires antisymmetric flavor indices: D_{[ij]}^{[ab]} with i \neq j. The three independent flavor-antisymmetric diquarks are:

  D_{[\mathfrak{u}\mathfrak{d}]},
  \quad
  D_{[\mathfrak{d}\mathfrak{s}]},
  \quad
  D_{[\mathfrak{s}\mathfrak{u}]}.

These correspond to the three Cooper pair species in the CFL condensate.
